newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee ends steady at 35.65/66 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee ends steady at 35.65/66 per dollar.

text.p: The Indian rupee closed steady at 35.65/66 per dollar on Tuesday, dealers said.
"One bank is ruling the roost," said a bank dealer. He said a major bank sold dollars in the morning session and soon entered the market as a buyer, sending confusing signals.

The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) was in the market buying dollars at 35.65 level, a dealer at a forex brokerage said. Premia on forward dollars continued to be soft on expectations of RBI taking steps to ease liquidity in its monetary policy to be announced this weekend.
